title: Bill Gates' live blue screen
caption:
Windows 98 met its first scanner on live TV, and the scanner won. 💙
A blue screen is Windows stopping everything on purpose when a driver does something illegal, before it can wreck your data.
What's the worst time a computer has crashed on you?
sources: COMDEX/Spring and Windows World, Chicago, 20 April 1998: Windows 98 plug-and-play demo with a scanner ends in a blue screen; Bill Gates: "That must be why we're not shipping Windows 98 yet."
Microsoft Learn, Bug check (blue screen) basics: the system stops when kernel-mode code such as a driver does something illegal, to prevent data corruption
